latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Summer Camp Readiness Packet.

- Organizes camp information into a single readiness packet for parents and guardians.
- Generates a categorized packing list, tailored to camp type and duration.
- Includes medication and health info organizer for camp staff preparation.
- Provides sections for emergency contacts and pickup authorization.
- Offers a list of questions for camp staff and a parent-child conversation guide.
- Designed to reduce missed forms, forgotten essentials, and pre-camp anxiety.
